item.title: Employer health premiums rise 8% as workers shoulder more of the cost
item.description: Average family premiums for employer-sponsored insurance rose 8 percent this year, according to a new survey, with employees paying a larger share through deductibles.

item.title: Bipartisan group floats apprenticeship tax credit for companies that train workers
item.description: A bipartisan proposal would give companies a credit for each registered apprentice who completes a program with transferable credentials.
